# Recovery and sleep

Strides after an easy run keep the legs quick without adding fatigue. Most weekly mileage should be easy enough to hold a conversation. Shoes should fit with a thumb width of space in front of the longest toe.

## Notes

Increase total distance by about ten percent per week and take a lighter week every month. In hot weather slow down by pace, not by effort, and drink before you feel thirsty. Sleep is the cheapest recovery tool; a short night shows up in the next workout. Shoes should fit with a thumb width of space in front of the longest toe.

Sleep is the cheapest recovery tool; a short night shows up in the next workout. A long run at the weekend builds endurance; keep it slow and steady.

## Steps

- Shoes should fit with a thumb width of space in front of the longest toe.
- Taper for ten days before a half marathon so the legs arrive fresh.
- Intervals such as six times eight hundred metres build speed without the strain of a full race.
- Strides after an easy run keep the legs quick without adding fatigue.
